args.summary: Deployed hotfix v2.3.2 to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west), replacing unhealthy v2.3.1. Prior to deployment, v2.3.1 was unhealthy with an 18% error rate; v2.3.2 rollout verified healthy with error rate reduced to 0.2%. This incident records the change. This incident is informational/tracking only — no active outage.
args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to production

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary:

1. **Pre-deployment check**: Production was running v2.3.1, which was unhealthy (18% error rate) across us-east, us-west, and eu-west. Since v2.3.2 had never been in production, the deployment was routed for change-manager approval per policy.

2. **Deployment**: Shipped checkout-api **v2.3.2** to all three production regions — rollout completed successfully.

3. **Verification**: Post-deployment health check confirmed v2.3.2 is **healthy** in all regions, with the error rate down from 18% to **0.2%**.

4. **Incident recorded**: Opened **SEV3 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to production") documenting the change and the health verification. The incident is open and the on-call engineer has been paged.

Note: the incident did page on-call, so if that's not desired for a pure record-keeping incident, you may want to have on-call downgrade or resolve it.
